caption: The drawing depicts a semi-circular lace collar design rendered in fine, light gray pencil lines on a beige background. The collar features a scalloped outer edge with a double layer of repeating small, petal-like shapes. Inside the collar, there are six evenly spaced decorative motifs consisting of delicate branches with small leaves and clusters of flower shapes, all connected by curving stems. Below the main collar design, two additional decorative elements are drawn separately: one small flower on the left and a longer, curved leafy branch on the right. The bottom right corner contains a small hand-written inscription. The overall composition is centered, with the main collar design occupying the upper and middle portions of the paper, while the two smaller motifs are placed below it.
title: Collar
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
